title: Genome of a novel lysogenic bacteriophage infecting Achromobacter denitrificans
description: This project aims to isolate and characterize a novel lysogenic bacteriophage from Achromobacter denitrificans. We performed whole-genome sequencing of this phage to identify key regulatory genes involved in its life cycle and host interaction.
center: The First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University
samples: Novel lysogenic phage from hospital wastewater infecting Achromobacter denitrificans
